card.name: Just before interacting drug names
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas, or the start of a drug name right before an interacting drug is named in an interaction list. Seen in lists of CYP3A4 inhibitors, nitrates, and PDE-5 inhibitors.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'or' inside a list of interacting drugs, just before the next drug.
modes.example: discontinuation of a CYP3A4 inducer, such as rifampin<<,>> carbamazepine, and phen

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name that is split into parts, within an interacting-drug list.

modes.label: Linking word before the interacting agent
modes.description: Words like 'with', 'of' or 'taking' that lead into the interacting drug or drug class.
modes.example: patients using any form<< of>> organic nitrate is contraindicated

card.writes: Suppresses inhaler and controller-type tokens and promotes odd name fragments, so no clear meaning for the output.
card.plain: It lights up in drug-interaction lists just before the next interacting drug is named.
